title: Geo Register Plugin for 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes
summary: An open-source Python tool for georeferencing 3D Gaussian Splatting models to real-world coordinates using image EXIF metadata or external CSV logs. It enables professional GIS integration by exporting scenes to 3D Tiles 1.1, LAS, and LAZ formats.
research_notes: Utilizes a robust RANSAC + Umeyama solver for outlier-resistant coordinate alignment; features a 'No Scene' mode for processing standalone PLY files using existing similarity matrices.

evolution.summary: The project expanded from basic EXIF registration to supporting high-accuracy imports from RealityScan and Agisoft Metashape. It introduced SPZ v3 compression for 14x smaller file sizes and full compatibility with CesiumJS and ArcGIS via 3D Tiles 1.1.
